zero_shot.split: pinned mirror test split; not asserted to be the paper's original split
zero_shot.prompts: 10 prompts exactly follow a photo of a {class} and align with the verified EuroSAT class order
zero_shot.prediction_label_score_audit: passed: stored predictions, labels, counts and accuracy agree
zero_shot.interpretation: These unusually low per-class values were checked against class order, prompt strings and stored prediction/label scoring; no alignment defect was detected. Treat as measured model behavior, not as evidence to silently remap labels.

target_layers.scope: 12 CLIP vision-transformer blocks; q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj, mlp.fc1 and mlp.fc2
target_layers.visual_projection: excluded; transformer-block target count yields the reported ordinary-LoRA budget, but this count alone is not proof of E2 correctness
target_layers.parameter_formula: sum over target linears of rank * (in_features + out_features); no adapter biases

e2lora_blocker.paper_displayed_budget: approximately 0.66M for E2LoRA rank-8 versus approximately 1.31M for LoRA rank-8
e2lora_blocker.reason: The literal paper-policy pilot allocates a total rank sum almost equal to the independent LoRA rank budget; recomputation of unique shared factors matches the recorded adapter count, which is not close to the paper's displayed half-budget. The paper/report does not authorize applying the text partial-rank scheme to the image model.
e2lora_blocker.decision: Do not launch a formal E2LoRA pair or alter rank allocation, freeze factors, or sharing to force parameter parity. Continue independent baseline and scoring work; revisit only with a defensible source-grounded interpretation.

formal_lora_unit.live_job_and_checkpoint: Use the attempt-3 task entry in runs.json; it is updated after each segment by the acheng continuation controller.

scope_decisions.p0: audit split, prompt/score, target matrices and literal parameter policy
scope_decisions.p1: finish the registered 30-epoch EuroSAT LoRA seed-2026 and reuse the audited full EuroSAT zero-shot result
scope_decisions.p2: after P1, prefer a complete EuroSAT LoRA seed-2027 run if time permits; label it as a single baseline replicate, not a paired E2 result or three-seed stability estimate
